full_judgment: 3. Then, opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted Title Suit No. 118 of 1999 in the Second court of Subordinate Judge at Sylhet against the petitioner and 30 (thirty) others for declaration of title by way of purchase as well as adverse possession and further declaration that SA record of rights prepared in the name of defendant No. 25 is incorrect and of no legal effect and the Kabalas dated 5-8-74 and 1-6-77 of the predecessor-in- interest of defendant Nos. 1 to 3, and defendant Nos. 4 and 5 and predecessor-in-interest of defendant Nos. 6 to 10 and defendant No. 11 respectively are forged, collusive, void and also for confirmation of possession and perpetual injunction.
